title: Faraday cage test at the Monroe Institute

tellings.quote: So, we were at the Monurro Institute and they took me in the basement of the lab and put me in a Faraday cage

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a man who says UFOs show up around him and whom scientists have studied, says that in 2025 at the Monroe Institute in Virginia, a centre that studies the mind and consciousness, he was taken to the basement of the lab and put inside a Faraday cage, a metal enclosure that blocks outside radio and electrical signals. He tells it as something he went through himself, and mentions the retired Army officer John B. Alexander, the businessman Brandon Fugal and a Dr. Thompson in connection with the work. The point of such a test is to see what happens around him when all outside signals are shut out.
